authority: Sensitivity only; no fair-value or consensus claim
latest_quarter_annualization: Revenue and issuer/free-cash-flow proxy times4, not TTM or expected seasonality
shares: Last reported weighted-average diluted shares as an explicit capital-table proxy, not current issued shares
cash: Unrestricted cash only; marketable securities/investments and leases are separately excluded limitations
basis: Fixed diagnostic assumptions selected before calculator execution, not calibrated to price or realized returns
native_full_dcf: Fail closed if complete FCFF, capital and discount inputs absent
